f"""
        with current as materialized (
            select tasks.id, lower(coalesce(tasks.status, '')) as status,
                   tasks.updated_at, tasks.error
            {current_projection}
        ), counts as (
            select status, count(*) as count from current group by status
        ), latest as (
            select updated_at from current order by updated_at desc, id desc limit 1
        ), latest_error as (
            select error from current where status in ('failed', 'error')
            order by updated_at desc, id desc limit 1
        )
        select counts.status, counts.count, latest.updated_at, latest_error.error
        from counts cross join latest left join latest_error on 1=1
        order by counts.status
        """

f"""
        with current as materialized (
            select lower(coalesce(a.status, '')) as status, a.attempt_count,
                   a.next_attempt_at, a.updated_at, a.error, a.action_id
            {current_plan}
        ), counts as (
            select status, count(*) as count,
                   sum(case when status='failed' and attempt_count < ?
                        and trim(next_attempt_at) != ''
                        and datetime(next_attempt_at) is not null
                       then 1 else 0 end) as retryable
            from current group by status
        ), latest as (
            select updated_at, error from current
            order by updated_at desc, action_id desc limit 1
        )
        select counts.status, counts.count, counts.retryable, latest.updated_at, latest.error
        from counts cross join latest order by counts.status
        """

f"""
                select error_event.id, error_event.conversation_id,
                       error_event.message_id, error_event.kind,
                       error_event.detail, error_event.created_at
                from errors error_event
                where coalesce(error_event.resolved_at, '') = ''
                  and error_event.kind <> 'codex_capacity_pause'
                  and not exists (
                    select 1
                    from errors newer_error
                    where newer_error.conversation_id=error_event.conversation_id
                      and coalesce(newer_error.message_id, '')=
                          coalesce(error_event.message_id, '')
                      and newer_error.kind=error_event.kind
                      and newer_error.id>error_event.id
                      and coalesce(newer_error.resolved_at, '')=''
                  )
                  and not (
                    error_event.conversation_id='work_summary_input'
                    and exists (
                      select 1
                      from ({WORK_SUMMARY_INPUT_SQL}) as completed_input
                      where cast(completed_input.id as text)=error_event.message_id
                        and lower(completed_input.status) in ('done', 'skipped')
                    )
                  )
                  and not exists (
                    select 1
                    from ({REPLY_ATTEMPT_COMMON_SQL}) recovery
                    where recovery.conversation_id=error_event.conversation_id
                      and recovery.trigger_message_id=error_event.message_id
                      and datetime(recovery.updated_at) >= datetime(error_event.created_at)
                      and lower(recovery.send_status) in ({recovered_placeholders})
                  )
                  and not exists (
                    select 1
                    from (
                        select event_run.id, event_run.scheduled_task_id
                        from ({SCHEDULED_RUN_SQL}) as event_run
                        where event_run.event_id=error_event.message_id
                        union all
                        select identity_run.id, identity_run.scheduled_task_id
                        from ({SCHEDULED_RUN_SQL}) as identity_run
                        where identity_run.id=cast(substr(
                            error_event.conversation_id,
                            length('scheduled-task-run:') + 1
                        ) as integer)
                          and error_event.conversation_id=
                              'scheduled-task-run:' || cast(identity_run.id as text)
                    ) as stale_run
                    where exists (
                         select 1
                         from ({SCHEDULED_RUN_SQL}) as later_run
                         join ({REPLY_TASK_SQL}) as later_task
                           on later_run.execution_kind='reply_task'
                          and cast(later_run.execution_id as integer)=later_task.id
                          and lower(later_task.status) in ('done', 'skipped')
                         where later_run.scheduled_task_id=stale_run.scheduled_task_id
                           and later_run.id>stale_run.id
                           and later_run.dispatch_status='dispatched'
                     )
                  )
                order by error_event.created_at desc, error_event.id desc
                """
